The issuer displays severe financial distress, evidenced by negative operating profitability (EBIT of -$459M) and substantial net losses (-$640M), alongside an extremely high leverage profile with total liabilities ($11,824M) making up over 96% of total assets ($12,240M) and eroding equity to just $415M. While current assets provide short-term liquidity cover against current liabilities, the unsustainable capital structure and ongoing cash burn create a significant risk of default or restructuring in the near to medium term.

DECISION: CCC+
